title: Complete Guide to Serverless Architecture
description: Runnable event-driven pipeline from the guide's worked example: S3-triggered resize Lambda, SQS queue with DLQ, metadata Lambda writing to DynamoDB with batchItemFailures, plus Terraform for the full stack.
description_es: Pipeline event-driven ejecutable del ejemplo resuelto de la guía: Lambda de resize disparada por S3, cola SQS con DLQ, Lambda de metadata que escribe en DynamoDB con batchItemFailures, más Terraform para todo el stack.
